title: Food-Loss Payment on Northgate Protect Standard Plans: Amount Payable
content:
On a Northgate Protect Standard 2-Year or Standard 3-Year plan, the food-loss payment for food lost when a covered refrigerator or freezer fails is figured as follows.

**Claim paid.** The food-loss claim paid is the latest food-loss claim filed on the plan, and the food loss claimed is the amount recorded on that claim; where two food-loss claims share the latest filing date, it is the one listed first on the plan's ledger. That claim's incident date and filing date are the ones recorded on it.

**Remaining share.** The item's remaining share is the limit of liability registered on the plan less the settlements already booked on the plan.

**Payment.** The food-loss payment is the food loss claimed held to the per-claim food-loss limit, which is the tier's food-loss maximum per claim, and no more than the item's remaining share, rounded half up to the cent.

**Order of assembly.** The per-claim food-loss limit is settled first, the food loss claimed is held to it, a share is then applied to that held amount, every allowance is added after that, and the result is held to no more than the item's remaining share and rounded half up to the cent once at the end; it is booked as a food-loss payment settlement of the food-loss claim.

## Worked examples on hypothetical figures

| Food loss claimed | Per-claim food-loss limit | Remaining share | Food-loss payment |
|---|---|---|---|
| $310.00 | $250.00 | $900.00 | $250.00 |
| $118.60 | $250.00 | $900.00 | $118.60 |
| $240.00 | $250.00 | $200.00 | $200.00 |

## Points of judgement

- Only the latest food-loss claim on the plan is paid by this figure; an earlier food-loss claim is not added to it.
- The remaining share counts every settlement already on the plan, whatever its kind.
